50.$description: The primary brand palette used across interactive elements: CTAs, links, inputs, active states, focus rings.
The brand secondary palette, used alongside primary green to indicate secondary focus.
Progress palette. Conveys progress, milestones, and reflective states.
Informational palette. Used for neutral information, tips, and informational states.
Success palette. Conveys positivity, completion, and successful states.
Warning palette. Conveys holding states, warnings, and on-hold states.
Warning palette. Conveys holding states, warnings, and on-hold states.
Error palette. Conveys negativity, failures, and error states.
Neutral palette. Supporting colors used for backgrounds, text, separators, and modal surfaces.
Dark surface palette. Purpose-built for dark mode surfaces with near-black variants.

White.$description: Pure white. Used as a primitive for surfaces and absolute light.

Off-White.$description: Soft off-white. Used as a supporting background tone.

Black.$description: Pure black. Used as a primitive for absolute dark and high-contrast text.

10.$description: White at 10% opacity. For light scrims and subtle overlays on dark images.
Black at 10% opacity. For subtle dividers and shadow tints.

50.$description: Black at 50% opacity. Used as the canonical modal scrim and full-screen overlay backdrop.

0.$description: No space. For collapse and reset.

2.$description: Hairline. Internal spacing on tight controls.

4.$description: Tight. Between an icon and its label.

8.$description: Compact. Internal padding on chips and small components.

24.$description: Sections. Default gap between content sections.

64.$description: Hero spacing. Top of a page.

8.$description: Default for small components: inputs, chips.

12.$description: Default for medium components: buttons, cards.

20.$description: Used by Safqah brand-aligned cards (v1 carries 20px).

32.$description: Extra large. Reserved for hero containers.

Full.$description: Fully rounded, pills, avatars, circular buttons.
